title: uncaria domatiifera subsp. myrmecophyta
intro: Uncaria domatiifera subsp. myrmecophyta, commonly known as the "Dancing Tiger Vine", is a unique, climbing plant that forms a symbiotic relationship with ants, providing them shelter in exchange for protection from herbivores and other threats. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Uncaria domatiifera subsp. myrmecophyta include modulating the immune system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antiviral and antifungal activities. Its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
